title: Cannot find module 'lru-cache/min' (something wrong from `@vue/compiler-sfc`)

labels.name: :hammer: p3-minor-bug
labels.description: Priority 3: this fixes a bug, but is an edge case that only affects very specific usage.

body: ### Vue version 3.3.7 ### Link to minimal reproduction [link repro - 1](https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-ivvjfm?file=index.ts) ### Steps to reproduce open repro ![CleanShot 2023-11-01 at 01 29 45](https://github.com/vuejs/core/assets/18424466/8c285b65-cc3c-4f3e-8e01-ae2d1dd542cd) ### What is expected? no error ### What is actually happening? error ``` node_modules/.pnpm/@vue+compiler-sfc@3.3.7/node_modules/@vue/compiler-sfc/dist/compiler-sfc.d.ts:1:32 - error TS2307: Cannot find module 'lru-cache/min' or its corresponding type declarations. 1 import * as lru_cache_min from 'lru-cache/min' Found 1 error in node_modules/.pnpm/@vue+compiler-sfc@3.3.7/node_modules/@vue/compiler-sfc/dist/compiler-sfc.d.ts:1 ``` ### Any additional comments? [v3.3.4](https://unpkg.com/browse/@vue/compiler-sfc@3.3.4/dist/compiler-sfc.d.ts) ![CleanShot 2023-11-01 at 01 25 01](https://github.com/vuejs/core/assets/18424466/5fa1b702-3647-4df1-ba5c-5cf21f5aaf0b) [v3.3.5](https://unpkg.com/browse/@vue/compiler-sfc@3.3.5/dist/compiler-sfc.d.ts) ![CleanShot 2023-11-01 at 01 26 21](https://github.com/vuejs/core/assets/18424466/2198bf11-69b0-47af-a646-590970736322) [lru-cache@10.0.1](https://unpkg.com/browse/lru-cache@10.0.1/) Install `lru-cache` independently is still failed because there is no `lru-cache/min`; I found this problem seems to be more related to `tsc`. [link repro - 2](https://stackblitz.com/edit/bsgyl7?file=tsconfig.json&file=tsconfig.json,dist%2Findex.d.ts&terminal=dev) ![CleanShot 2023-11-01 at 15 30 30](https://github.com/vuejs/core/assets/18424466/eed448ff-e01d-4333-ac67-61891114703e) ### Suggestion 1. added `lru-cache` to dependencies https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/9ca468c68bb1b84ce3ab5b4bedcabad3c2a7b618/packages/compiler-sfc/package.json#L50 2. set `node` instead of `bundler` on `moduleResolution` property or only instead for build(`tsconfig.build.json`), it will work fine. https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/9ca468c68bb1b84ce3ab5b4bedcabad3c2a7b618/tsconfig.json#L10 3. `npm run build-dts` ![CleanShot 2023-11-01 at 15 46 07@2x](https://github.com/vuejs/core/assets/18424466/740d4076-45d5-486a-bd5b-628c4bf6b21f) if it's not a bug, please close the issue. Because `moduleResolution` property set to `bundler` will work fine in my project.
